slug: 和女帝双修后我出剑即无敌
lines: “好姐姐，要不咱们稍微停一下，腰都快断了。”
郑元躺在地上一脸幸福并痛苦中，全身上下被一股真气禁锢中，想动动不了。
九天前！
自己被未婚妻偷袭，一掌被打下了万丈悬崖。
体内经脉尽断，身负重伤，眼看就要活不成了。
突然一道流光冲了下来，郑元的眼睛都看直了。
她肤若凝脂，呼之欲出的巍峨壮观，仿若破晓之霞，璀璨而夺目，艳色惊世无双。
那眉眼间的风情，恰似月华轻洒湖面，潋滟生光，举手投足皆有颠倒众生之能。
“小子，现在摆在你面前有三个选择，A：我一巴掌拍死你，b:你和我双修，c：”
瑶池女帝极力的压制着体内之毒问道。
b，b，b！
“我选b.”
郑元不等瑶池女帝把话说完，赶紧抢答道。
砰！
瑶池女帝身躯一震，身上的衣服化作了片片飞舞的蝴蝶。
肌肤白皙粉嫩，仿若羊脂玉净般，一双修长的玉腿没有一有一丝瑕疵。
但是！
一连九天，铁打的身子也受不了啊，
如今自己终于明白了，什么叫最难消受美人恩！
上面的瑶池女帝听到这话气得真想一巴掌呼过去。
自己一个修炼了万年的女帝，冰清玉洁之身都给了这小子，他居然还叫苦连天。
要不是当年被那个恶毒的女人暗算，身中九转合欢散，又身受重伤坠入凡尘，眼看压制不住体内之毒，否则怎么会和一个凡尘世俗小子双修，来化解体内之毒。
“闭嘴！”
瑶池女帝猛地一甩秀发，嘴里发出一声低鸣。
轰！
天空中忽然传来一道惊雷声，瞬间日月无光，仿佛天地要炸裂般。
郑元并没有被这话语吓到，反而是不争气的流下了两道鼻血。
“你难道忘了是怎么被未婚妻打下悬崖了吗？”
瑶池女帝的话让郑元飘走的心神瞬间又收了回来。
这里是天乾大陆，以武为尊，修炼境界划分为淬体境，开脉境，后天境，先天境，辟海境，造化境，神境等境界。
郑元出生在浩城里的一个大家族，十岁淬体，十一岁晋级淬体一层，十二岁晋级淬体二层，十六岁晋级淬体九层，十八岁晋级开脉一层境界。
郑家族长更是亲自为他挑选了一门亲事。
未婚妻是浩城王氏家族的掌上明珠王艳，虽然体质一般，但身材婀娜多姿，美丽动人。
郑元一见钟情，为了帮助未婚妻改善体质不惜血斗二级凶兽剑齿虎，终于得到一枚龙云果。
当郑元九死一生把龙云果送给未婚妻王艳后，却被她突然一掌拍下了万丈悬崖，身受重伤，经脉尽断。
本以为要丧命时无意间被身中奇毒的瑶池女帝给碰到了。
“王艳，你为什么如此对我？”
刚才沉思中的郑元双眼瞬间变得通红一片，嘴里突然发出一声大吼。
content_en:
Ah...
"Good sister, why don't we stop for a moment, our waist is almost broken."
…
Zheng Yuan was lying on the ground with a look of happiness and pain on his face. His whole body was imprisoned by a stream of true energy, making him unable to move even if he wanted to.
Nine days ago!
He was attacked by his fiancée and knocked off a cliff with a palm.
The meridians in his body were severed, he was seriously injured, and he was about to die.
Suddenly a stream of light rushed down, and Zheng Yuan's eyes widened.
Her skin is like cream, and she looks majestic and majestic, just like the dawn glow, bright and eye-catching, and her color is unparalleled in the world.
The amorous feelings between the eyebrows and eyes are just like the moonlight shining lightly on the lake, sparkling with light, and the movements of hands and feet have the ability to turn all living beings upside down.
"Boy, you have three choices before you now. A: I will slap you to death, b: You and I will practice together, c:"
The Empress of Yaochi asked while trying her best to suppress the poison in her body.
b, b, b!
"I choose b."
Zheng Yuan quickly answered without waiting for Empress Yaochi to finish her words.
Bang!
The body of the Yaochi Empress was shaken, and the clothes on her body turned into pieces of flying butterflies.
Her skin is fair and pink, as pure as mutton fat, and there is not a single flaw in her pair of slender jade legs.
……
but!
For nine days in a row, my iron-clad body couldn't bear it.
Now I finally understand what is the most difficult thing to accept the kindness of a beautiful woman!
The Empress of Yaochi above was so angry when she heard this that she really wanted to slap her in the face.
I am an empress who has been practicing for ten thousand years, and I gave her pure and pure body to this boy, but he still complains about it.
If he hadn't been plotted against by that vicious woman, he was poisoned by the Nine Revolutions, and fell into the mortal world with serious injuries. Seeing that he couldn't suppress the poison in his body, how could he have practiced dual cultivation with a secular boy in the mortal world to resolve the poison in his body.
"Shut up!"
The Empress of Yaochi flicked her hair and let out a low moan.
boom!
Suddenly there was a thunderous sound in the sky, and the sun and the moon became dark for an instant, as if the heaven and earth were about to explode.
Zheng Yuan was not frightened by these words. Instead, he shed two nosebleeds.
…
"Have you forgotten how you were knocked off a cliff by your fiancée?"
Empress Yaochi's words brought Zheng Yuan's mind back to him instantly.
This is the Tianqian Continent, where martial arts is respected, and the cultivation realms are divided into body tempering realm, pulse opening realm, acquired realm, innate realm, sea opening realm, creation realm, divine realm and other realms.
Zheng Yuan was born into a big family in Haocheng City. He underwent body tempering at the age of ten, advanced to the first level of body tempering at the age of eleven, the second level of body tempering at the age of twelve, the ninth level of body tempering at the age of sixteen, and the first level of opening pulses at the age of eighteen.
The head of the Zheng family even personally selected a marriage for him.
The fiancée is Wang Yan, the apple of the Wang family in Haocheng. Although she has an average physique, she has a graceful and beautiful figure.
Zheng Yuan fell in love at first sight, and in order to help his fiancée improve her physical condition, he fought a bloody battle with the second-level ferocious beast Sabertooth Tiger, and finally got a Dragon Cloud Fruit.
When Zheng Yuan escaped death and gave Long Yun Guo to his fiancée Wang Yanhou, he was suddenly slapped off a cliff by her palm. He was seriously injured and his meridians were severed.
When he thought he was about to die, he was accidentally touched by the Yaochi Empress who was poisoned by a strange poison.
…
"Wang Yan, why do you treat me like this?"
Zheng Yuan, who was deep in thought just now, his eyes instantly turned red, and he suddenly let out a loud roar.
